lines.speaker: anchor_op_r
lines.text: Ziz is heading straight for the Captain!

lines.speaker: helm_op_l
lines.text: Fire!

lines.speaker: mast_op_c
lines.text: Aye, aye, sir!
The anti-aircraft guns unleash a merciless barrage.
Ziz skillfully darts through the maelstrom of bullets and continues heading closer.
Far from stopping her, the fusillade only serves to slow her down slightly.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's probably going for the egg! Laplace!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hero Buster!
A beam of light shoots from the muzzle of Laplace's weapon, heading toward the descending Ziz.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hrrrrngh!
Ziz accelerates to mach speed, leaving only a black streak in the air which
makes it impossible to see her clearly.
Laplace's attack misses, and all the Admire's barrage hits is air.
Soon after, the black streak disappears from sight entirely.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... She disappeared?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Darn!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Above us!
*Boom*!
Ziz lands on the ground without us having seen her.
As she touches down, she slams into Laplace, crushing her.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Phew... pretty fast, don't you think?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: When I... when I put my mind to things, I'm not to be m-messed with!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I've got her!
Drake grabs the panting Ziz.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Get ready for the Drake Special!
*Buzzzzzz*!
Red electricity leaps out of Drake's body and scorches Ziz.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Haha, how do you like that?!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Urgh! H-how are you so strong?!
Ziz's wings spread open,
and Leviathan jumps out from inside.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Get lost!
Dark Matter pours from Ziz's wings,
and Drake is swept away by the black tide.
Only her face remains visible, with the rest of her trapped within the black mass.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Argh... so humiliating!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: *Cough*... Urgh...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ziz... the egg...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: On it!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's far enough.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We won't just hand over the egg to you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You guys need to talk to us.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I think we're past talking now.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I think I know what you're after.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We might be able to help each other.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Shut up.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're all just going to stab us in the back again!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I knew you would say that.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Once I take you down, we'll see how much you feel like talking.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You won't be able to catch up to me!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Those wings of yours need time to reach their top speed.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll catch you before then, and drill right through you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I can accelerate much faster than you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Eep!
Leviathan lifts the unconscious Laplace and Drake with Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Don't move,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: or I'll pump these two full of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Unless you want their brains floating in Dark Matter, you better stay right where you are.
Leviathan. We...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Shut up! Stop talking!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Looks like we have a hostage situation.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If Behemoth saw this, she'd be so disappointed.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I said stop talking! I'm not bluffing! I'll really do it!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: now I'm getting really angry.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Members of Matis being taken hostage? I don't think so.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Laplace! Drake!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Don't you find this humiliating?

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: I thought you two were the best Missilis had to offer!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Ahhhhhh!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Harrrrhh!
Electricity surges from Laplace and Drake's bodies,
causing them to turn a bright white.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What?! The Dark Matter is burning away?!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ziz! Throw them!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hyah!
Ziz grabs the electrified Laplace and Drake and launches into the air.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Agh, it hurts!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but I've got to listen to Leviathan!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Otherwise, she'll abandon me!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Arrrrgghhh!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I hate heights!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Where do you think you're going?
Rapi deploys her drill and pursues Ziz.
At the same moment, Leviathan spreads Dark Matter and blocks Rapi's path.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're not going anywhere!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Out of the way!
*Craaaaack*!
Rapi's drill pierces through the Dark Matter protecting Leviathan.
Fragments of Dark Matter scatter everywhere and terror flashes across Leviathan's face.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You can't stop me, now move!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I... I need to protect Behemoth!
*Kreeeeee*
Rapi stops directly in front of Leviathan,
and stops her drill.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Leviathan.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We need to talk.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Sh-shut up!
*Booooommm*!
A waterfall of Dark Matter pours over Rapi.
Rapi falls to the ground and doesn't move.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Phew... phew...!
Leviathan.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You don't get to say my name!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Don't talk to me!
We...
*Boom*!
Ziz lands on the ground.
Her hair and eyebrows are tinged with white frost.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: L-Leviathan! I dropped them from waaaaay high up!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: When they hit the ground, they'll be nothing but a splatter. You won't even be able to recognize 'em!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: How'd I do? Did I do good?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah yeah, good job.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hehe, I told you I'd do good!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Gaaaah! At this altitude, even a hero...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You idiot, stop talking about heroes and do something!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Can you two hear me?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Maxwell!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Help!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: I'll use the Admire's catapult to launch the power upgrade components your way.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: By calculating your speed of descent along with the velocity of the catapult's trajectory, we should be able to meet in the middle.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Obviously, I can't give precise coordinates, and I can't confirm if the parts will fit all that well,

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: but it's better than nothing.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Okay, fine! Just send them over!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Do the parts have a landing function?

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: No, it's just that their power output and durability are radically increased from what you have now.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: So we're just supposed to upgrade ourselves and then fall?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Don't worry, you'll be fine. Syuen made it, and I did some fine-tuning.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: This stuff was crafted by the greatest minds Missilis has to offer.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Not bad!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: When will the parts arrive?

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: They'll be heading your way soon.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: I have faith in you! You can do this!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Show me how special you both are!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Show those damned Heretics once and for all what happens when they mess with Matis!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Phew... phew... I'm tired.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: That leaves just one.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: ... But it's a real human? Not an Imposter?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wow, it's been ages since I saw a real...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Man? You're a man, aren't you?
That's right. And one cool hombre at that.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Leviathan!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: That's what we need!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Well then... shall we?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? Are you feeling okay? How come you don't have any energy?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: We won!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: And I played a big part in it! You ought to be praising me more.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Go on, tell me that I'm the best.
Ziz, was it?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: That's me!
Those two Nikkes you just tossed in the air, do you know what everyone in the Ark calls them?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? I don't know. What do they call them?
Heroes.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Heroes? Those two?
That's right.
And heroes are known for appearing from the sky.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: What in the world are you blabbering ab...
*Boom*!
With a resounding thunderclap
and blue and red flashes,
I see Laplace and Drake make a crash landing right on top of Leviathan and Ziz,
crushing them.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Have no fear, the hero's here!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Have no fear, the villain's here!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Don't move.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I'm not used to this new weapon of mine, and I've got a loose trigger finger.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Ditto!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: This is one heck of an upgrade.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Honestly, I didn't expect it to be this strong. It's almost overkill.
Huh? When did you two power up?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: While we were in the air.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: With a whoosh and a boom!
... Maxwell, can you make some sense of this?

lines.speaker: helm_op
lines.text: She's on the way.

lines.speaker: helm_op
lines.text: She had us catapult her over.
Catapult? You mean the launcher?

lines.speaker: helm_op
lines.text: Yeah. She wanted to get there ASAP.
I don't think that's meant to be firing Nikkes.

lines.speaker: helm_op
lines.text: You think I don't know that? She insisted.
*Boooom*!
Something comes plummeting down and crashes roughly on the ground.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Urgh!
After a minor commotion, Maxwell walks out from the resulting dust cloud.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Whew... very nice. This stuff is definitely durable, that's for sure.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Heck, I wonder if there's any point in being tactical anymore.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Er... I should be careful. Eunhwa would tear me a new one if she heard me say that.
You powered up too, Maxwell?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: This whole upgrade program was intended for Matis, and I'm part of Matis, aren't I?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Where's Laplace and Drake?
I point to the two of them.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: how are you two feeling?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: What else can we say? We feel like a million bucks!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: This power is almost frightening.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Good, good.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: To be honest, I'm not really in the talking mood,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: but I suppose we can take pity on these weaker cretins.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: All right you two bozos, it's time we have a conversation.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: And just so you know, we're not asking you. We're telling you.
